name: Decline Twisting Sit-Up
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a decline and secure your legs under the upper foot pads.
Lie back with your arms crossed over your chest or fingertips lightly beside your temples.
Sit up while rotating your rib cage so one shoulder turns toward the opposite thigh.
Unwind smoothly as you lower back to the pad and alternate the twisting direction.
tips: Rotate through your chest while keeping your pelvis centered on the pad.
Move with control instead of yanking your head or using momentum off the bench.
